title: Muammar Gaddafi to Clifford the Big Red Dog in three real photos
description: A 2009 summit photo, a White House welcome and an Easter Egg Roll connect Libya's Muammar Gaddafi to Clifford the Big Red Dog.
hook: How is Muammar Gaddafi connected to Clifford the Big Red Dog?

links.line: In 2009, Gaddafi posed beside Barack Obama at the G8 summit in Italy, where the two shook hands.
In 2009, on Inauguration Day, Barack Obama walked Laura Bush and her husband to their farewell helicopter.
